requirements.text: Provide real-time notifications for transactions including transaction amount, merchant name, and remaining balance.
Allow users to customize notification preferences for transaction alerts, payment due reminders, and spending threshold alerts.
Implement biometric authentication options, specifically fingerprint and facial recognition, for secure login.
Integrate biometric authentication for sensitive actions within the app, such as approving payments.
Provide in-app lending capabilities allowing users to apply for personal loans, overdraft increases, or credit limit adjustments.
Streamline the loan application process to require basic personal and financial information for credit assessment.
Integrate with open banking APIs to pull in relevant financial data for loan applications, with user consent.
Ensure compliance with PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication for payment initiations and sensitive account access.
Ensure compliance with GDPR regulations for customer data storage and processing within the European Economic Area.
Maintain integration with the existing core banking system without making changes to the mainframe.
Maintain backwards compatibility with the existing app for at least six months during the transition period.
Provide users with quick turnaround notifications on the status of their loan applications.
